claims.statement: workspace-review-context supports repeated --path for an explicit-scope review: Git reads are restricted to the requested literal paths, every requested path receives BASE context, --max-paths selection is not applied, and every other committed or working change is disclosed as NOT_ASSESSED. Automatic whole-change review remains the default and keeps file-level untracked expansion for selecting new files.

attributes.scope: Caller-selected review scope over 1..32 repository file paths; no directories, globs or inferred paths
attributes.claim_ceiling: One implementation and scratch/real-checkout probes; independent-agent benefit NOT TESTED and timings are environment-specific
attributes.rejected_alternative: Change automatic review to entry-level untracked paths or skip expansion conditionally; rejected because the reviewed review carve-out still requires file-level selection whenever untracked files can fill the context budget.

attributes.scope: Explicit caller-selected review scope within the capability
Review command and workspace read implementation

attributes.relationship: preserves the automatic review default and its file-level untracked selection; adds a caller-selected scope
